title: Xining, Qinghai — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Xining, Qinghai: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Xining is a city in Qinghai with a population of 2,467,000. Capital of Qinghai province on the Tibetan Plateau, a gateway to Qinghai Lake and Kumbum Monastery with a distinct Tibetan-Hui cultural mix. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 270 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
